summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return (Hong Kong exchange filing) detailing ongoing share repurchases for cancellation. The report lists multiple open-market buybacks between March 20 and April 15, 2026, at prices ranging from USD 6.57 to USD 7.14 per share. As of May 7, 2026, issued shares remain at 840,422,467. Repurchased shares are not yet canceled but are held pending cancellation. The buybacks return capital to shareholders and reduce share count over time. Monitor the pace of future repurchases and any change in the buyback authorization for risk-arb considerations.
